info.title: API-DocTest-List Auto Insurance Quotes Documents-v5-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Document Retrieval API enables users to access and retrieve relevant documents associated with auto insurance quotes. This API is designed to streamline the process of managing and reviewing insurance documents, providing a robust solution for insurers, brokers, and policyholders. Typical consumers include insurance companies looking to improve document accessibility and agents seeking to facilitate customer interactions. With a simple GET request, users can efficiently obtain the necessary documentation for informed decision-making and service enhancement.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of quote documents.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the list of all available quote documents from the system. It provides an efficient way to access the documents related to quotes for review or further processing.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching quote documents. This should contain necessary parameters for querying the documents.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the requested documents.

ListAutoInsuranceQuotesDocumentsRequest.description: A JSON string representing the body of a GET request for document operations.

ListAutoInsuranceQuotesDocumentsResponse.title: Quote Document Operation Response

status.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the quote reference.

resultId.description: The identifier of the result from the operation.

state.description: The current state of the quote operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit history of the quote document.

ListAutoInsuranceQuotesDocumentsResponse.description: The response object for the GET operation retrieving quote document details.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the document.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the document was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the document creation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Details about the auditing process of the document.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time (in milliseconds) taken by the server to process the request. A lower value generally indicates a more efficient operation.
